scope: Read-only catalog/source reconciliation and implementation queue. No runtime code or production data lifecycle changes.
runtime_revision: not independently verified; thread handoff reports deployed 27046e0c2dfc
measurement: UTF-8 bytes of compact JSON serialization of the complete returned CallToolResult including text escaping and structuredContent when present; excludes HTTP and JSON-RPC framing. These are live sample sizes, not universal bounds.

checks.observation: Rule summaries page with next_offset and exact packet reader.
Unknown-only selection is an error, never successful aggregate completion.
A registered project identity filter succeeds without checkout write authority.
Empty result retains compact degraded/unavailable counts and exact diagnostics hint; no diagnostic bodies archived.
Accepted source commit 00482264 observed with CAS tokens and compact health; this is not a runtime binary revision check.
Returned native transcript hits with transcript recovery hints; did not exercise non-transcript hit recovery.
Default orientation observed; installed agents omitted; byte measurement is one live sample.
Explicit detail=summary returns unknown-detail error despite adapter acceptance; default summary and note recovery work.
Content-bound pages reconstruct the entire stored JSON note; body and opaque cursors not archived.

limits: Source review and inspected regressions are not newly executed tests.
The existing 173-check isolated run is reported by the handoff, not rerun here; the checked-in integration receipt is an earlier checkpoint.
No destructive probes, durable-memory writes, credential injections, provider dispatches, or shared-service mutations ran; existing knowledge and thread records were read.
Catalog replay proves policy discovery, not callable access from this client.
No raw bodies, credential values, other-project identities, or native session locators are archived.

source_catalog.method: Exact tool name declarations in src/tools/*.rs at source_revision; compared to all replay pages.

action_coverage.count_semantics: Historical branch labels are preserved. New refinements subdivide existing rows and are not disjoint action counts or invented action parameter values.

groups.contract: Callable compatibility no-op, now labeled and omitted from hot docs. Still does view/diagnostic work; no successful import outcome. Confirm external consumers before removing discovery.

First/all result summaries, finding pages and exact result JSON implemented. Exact reads suppress observation writes and bind input/result. Opaque entity and consequent validation still needs branch probes.
Typed kind, exactly one inline or HTTP input, inline byte cap and staged failure reporting. Nested artifact shape remains opaque; installation is distinct from catalog activation.
Collection pages exist, but a huge description or supersession chain can overflow one receipt row. No exact artifact receipt reader; offset movement is not disclosed in the response.
Operator-directed removal with confirmation guard. Preserve historical receipt versus runtime removal distinctions; no destructive acceptance in this pass.
Useful lifecycle operation, but returns raw ArtifactMetadata including source URL, project path, warnings and chain. Synthetic disclosure/size proof required; no live secret leak asserted.

Bounded mismatches/findings and complete exact result pages implemented. Changed input/result invalidates cursor; exact reads add no event. Probe malformed expected values and mode-specific skipped rows.
Indexed anchor provenance and local Git fallback remain distinct authority lanes; an origin result is evidence of authorship/history, not correctness.
Immediate compatibility refusal with replacement hint. Hidden from default discovery and hot docs, still served on ops; removal requires compatibility decision.
Entity/path/edge count caps exist, but full properties, metadata and echoed question are not a producer byte bound. Property readers recover individual values, not every oversized bundle envelope.
Claim-origin retrieval remains useful. A retrieved statement is not proof of its truth.
Rules now include usable examples and restrictions, but nested JSON remains opaque and chooser is long. Keep compilation separate from evaluating/classifying entities.
Native coordinate reads disclose indexed projection/freshness limits; retained conversation reads use scoped landing-store authority. Do not claim current source completeness from indexed retrieval.
Real harness id/text consumer requires this compatibility shape. Empty-index path can trigger indexing; overlap in name does not justify retirement.
Operator-approved durable commitment with rationale and supersession. Owner admission, local persistence and publication remain distinct; transport repair is separately owned.
Default vocabulary is still large; installed-agent expansion is unpaged. Current default measured 15282 complete result bytes, one sample. Make orientation compact and agent inventory recoverable.
Adds notable edges to hybrid retrieval and requires a complete graph read view; not an identical search alias.
Section-targeted collection and full JSON pages implemented, but catalog producers cap findings before DoctorReport. Exact pages cannot recover those omitted findings.
Distinct legacy compaction with backup and optional rebuild. A later rebuild error currently loses completed compaction evidence; preserve a partial receipt.

Validated list/prune/scrub choices, paged and exact preview inventory, explicit age/route, pre-effect prune batch refusal and partial deletion counts implemented. Scrub still scans one entire mapped partition; stress arbitrary route/entity fields.

Coverage, graph diagnostics and recall probes remain explicit expensive opt-ins; cheap status preserves failures/losses. Default 64-route diagnostic selection is not a bound on all caller-supplied names or nested reports.
Bounded traversal and direction-preserving cached paths remain useful. Move runbook-scale chooser prose to cold docs while keeping identity/readiness prerequisites.
Retirement/supersession differs from creating knowledge. Preserve explicit owner, approval and queued-publication semantics.
First-class deduplicated substrate record. Project mutation is queued to the checkout owner; this pass observed admission before independently checking delivery.
Resolution and paired supersession remain distinct. Paired admission does not imply atomic owner delivery; existing transport dependency owns that guarantee.
Existing-record edits compose through the owner queue; do not recreate occurrences to update evidence. This pass uses the existing audit gap and leaves it unresolved.
Typed filters, summary pages and visibility signals work. Exact ID/full still serialize the whole record, with no body cursor when a single record exceeds the envelope.
Default retains identity and degradation, debug adds ranking telemetry. Top-k is selection, not an exhaustive inventory; adversarial metadata/debug bounds remain verification work.
Section row/preview caps and expansion hints remain; adapter appends visibility/provenance afterward. Prove complete envelope under high diagnostic fanout.
Summary/smart/full, exact property pages and edge cursors preserve projection/freshness limits. Exact reads cannot expand content omitted during ingestion.

Exact entry/system-memory/diagnostic pages and compact diagnostics implemented. Normal text still emits complete title/provider metadata; limit lacks a maximum, memory category ignores it, packet histograms grow.
Durable knowledge relationships preserve owner and publication semantics; no new mutation acceptance claimed.
Operator-approved rendered rules remain distinct from cold facts and active threads. Owner queue completion is not accepted publication.
Unpaged issue text and full titles/duplicate groups remain, followed by session diagnostics. Recovery hint uses obsolete blackbox_review; add bounded findings and correct reader.

Typed actions, list-selector rejection, live row paging and exact policy/packet hints implemented and partly live checked. Complex predicates still display matches_surface=*; arbitrary policy strings and echoed selectors need growth proof.
Exact session/locator reads retain body/count bounds and native projection limitations; they do not read the caller filesystem.

Host-owned project association uses catalog/filter identity without checkout write authority. Unresolved note projects deliberately preserve literal compatibility, unlike pin mutation; document the distinction.
Single/batch IDs validate before mutation and output is compact, but no batch cardinality/input-byte cap exists. Add a pre-effect bound without changing atomic selection validation.
Live-offset summaries plus exact content-bound JSON readers implemented; stale and cross-note cursor tests exist. Exact reads preserve complete Unicode records.
Closed operation/outcome enums, timestamp validation, append-aware cursor pages and exact event body implemented. Whole-log scan cost remains independent of response bounds.
Packet AST expressiveness has a distinct record surface; general MCP deficits use the gap store.
Row/byte pages and exact packet body exist. Detail classification histograms can overflow a row and require a summary retry; expose explicit live-offset and recovery semantics.

Host-owned identity, early scope/action validation, live summary pages and exact pin JSON implemented. Project-filter read and invalid scope verified live; wrong-action field validation remains incomplete.

Local authority/identity marker required; transport-owned and remote-only attachment refuses. Recorded capabilities are observations. Stress alias nomination result fanout before claiming full bounds.

Aliases/attachments page with epoch refusal; observations returns one bounded projection and rejects paging controls. Recorded-authority wording is explicit. Nonzero get offset requires epoch; preserve that distinction from catalog list.
Authoritative logical-project discovery in catalog mode, bounded rows with optional epoch continuation. Unavailable in bridge mode, so not a universal project_list replacement.
Path-free set/clear with epoch and bounded reason. Catalog choice is not present filesystem authority.
Path-free transaction remains useful. census_row_removed=false conflates no row with lifecycle-guard failure; distinguish partial auxiliary cleanup from catalog detach.

Local-only migration of central knowledge into repo-owned files; the project stays registered. Partial repository, central-store and marker outcomes are now explicit; missing-root lifecycle belongs to its existing owner.
Compact descriptor, exact schema/descriptor pages and variant pagination/selectors implemented with content-bound cursors. Preserve source/checkout/hash identity.
Row/byte pages, deterministic order and nonzero-offset stamp checks implemented. Changed views refuse continuation; do not call the mutable inventory a permanent snapshot.
Error row and exact error pages implemented. Outer summary still collects every visible variant, unlike describe; high variant fanout needs a producer bound.
Checkout identity/config initialization remains useful. Lead chooser with the actual owning host/collector prerequisite.
Unpaged compatibility root view still has bridge parity and documentation consumers. Catalog list is unavailable in bridge mode; establish bridge replacement before consolidation.
Existing local/offline authority lane with improved chooser and transport-owned refusal. No remote capability inferred from a truthful refusal.
Source exclusivity, candidate ref, CAS, dry-run and pointer-swap uncertainty implemented across establishment/advance branches. Preserve admission versus accepted publication.
Useful attachment-only rebinding; covered projects refuse. Put the restriction in chooser before the failing call.
Compact health/connector and exact content/epoch-bound pages implemented; CAS identity survives. Raw auto_advance.last_attempt still escapes projection; detail_limit validation and chooser disagree.
Source-host checkout registration is distinct from logical catalog listing. Clarify owner prerequisite and catalog versus bridge follow-up reader.
Explicit local administrator operation, dry-run and partial failure reporting implemented. Transport-owned refusal is intentional.
Local/offline authority and operator-owned acknowledgement remain explicit; transport-owned scope refuses before probes. Planning cost is separate from reply size.
Compatibility action has real mode split: bridge unregister versus catalog detach, with offline logical retirement guidance. Preserve useful data/consumers before consolidation.
Legacy all-project Git notes mutation has local CLI overlap. Later note-write failure loses already-completed counts; retain partial receipt and review real legacy consumers before removal.
Bounded session-authoritative generation-bound plan has a real bro CLI consumer that restarts stale generations. Keep distinct from writing notes.
Local Git notes-to-sidecar operation; covered-project refusal precedes leases. Chooser should expose owner requirements; retirement needs legacy consumer/data review.

Starts convergence rather than pruning. Required bucket route supports all/backfill and explicit transcript guard; receipt says refill started, enqueue result only logged. Expose route vocabulary and observation limits.
Indexed-ref preflight works remotely; raw file refs need checkout authority. Ref cardinality alone does not bound arbitrary identities or aggregate reply bytes.
Queue admission and explicit wait-for-completion are separate. Empty-project authority stays operator supplied; no collected-source publication claim from a daemon scan.
Cold durable recall retains operator approval and owner/publication distinctions, without ambient rendering.
Host/global CLI and managed project owner lanes remain useful. Chooser hides prerequisites; appended diagnostics still need complete-envelope proof.
Bounded live queue and exact record pages implemented. Local mutation validation exists, but queued approve/reject drops forbidden cursor/limit before validation; move validation before enqueue.

All 13 branches remain executable: state, links, ranking, promotion and rendering. Existing owner gap covers consumer/data decision. List/search lack continuation and exact get/render bodies remain unpaged; ownership of a retirement decision does not discharge those contracts. default_template is missing from action prose; repeated promote hints incorrectly use bro_resume for thread IDs.

Typed SearchRecovery now routes native, retained conversation, thread and generic entity hits to valid readers or explicit unavailability. Current live query only exercised native hits; other types have inspected regressions.
Exact indexed session metadata has a distinct role from message pages and global session discovery.
Recency list has actual default/max 30/100; chooser lacks limits, project and empty-result semantics. Preserve source freshness caveats.
Cached index/segment counts with stated 60-second cache limit; no source-freshness inference.
Preview/apply and immutable summary/candidate/deleted/error/exclusion/full/packet receipt readers stay distinct. Partial stages survive; reading receipts never authorizes or repeats deletion.
Relative diagnostic file pages are byte bounded with explicit live offsets. Summary/files still scan before projection; paths identify daemon storage, not caller recovery files.

One selector resolver now handles preview/apply paths, IDs and aliases. Preview pages; apply refuses page selectors and requires one project. Still plans before slicing; specialist consumer review remains.

Default summary, history and exact note/handoff pages implemented. Explicit summary fails live. Mutation bag ignores get-only fields; truncated topic/session/edge metadata need valid exact recovery breadcrumbs.
Bounded summaries and catalog/historical-path filters work without checkout leases. Last-activity ordering is a live view; updates can move rows.

Typed kind/time, candidate-offset continuation and bounded previews exist; empty nonterminal pages are deliberate. Oversized locator reports recovery unavailable; full-envelope escaped-field proof remains.
Top terms are a distinct session profile; not a substitute for reading evidence.
Stored manifest, resolved brofile, metadata and complete computed-summary pages now recover oversized fields. Actual runtime permission planes are explicitly partial; distinct from stored get.
Manifest validation, custom-adapter refusal, authority checks and attribution add value over raw exec. No new provider execution in this pass.

Lifecycle/manifest summary and exact redacted manifest pages implemented; complete metadata recovers through bro_agent_describe(detail_plane=metadata). Field-specific redaction is not a claim that arbitrary prose is sanitized.
Filter-before-paging and sorted identity summaries; expanded list is not exact manifest replacement. Specialist discovery does not mean this client can call it.
Full descriptions/when-to-use/anti-pattern arrays remain per hit; total_matched is only returned length and vector telemetry is always present. Use existing exact readers for expanded text.
Save errors propagate and exact probe pages exist. Corrupt loads become empty, contradictory clear/update/cooldowns silently choose, and update can persist before invalid cursor rejection.

Independent compact inventories and exact config/preview/in-flight/probes/leases planes implemented. Current versus expired runtime quota distinguished; all inventories and allocation preview still computed before paging.
Compact summary and exact change-bound trace pages implemented. Opaque raw diagnostic prose is not guaranteed credential-sanitized.
Pre-effect member/receipt caps and ordinary-loop per-child outcomes implemented. Later filter resolution can early-return after prior admission; final team save has no durable-result status.

Exact selected-scope brofile/account pages, redacted inventory and strict config mutation implemented. Read helpers still collapse malformed/unreadable stores to empty/not-found; some summary identities grow and project locality needs clarity.
Distinct cancellation control; no peer task controlled in this pass.
Bounded status/filter projection and early selector validation implemented. Ordinary context telemetry stays omitted.
Fresh dispatch, selector alternatives and request-key replay preserve reservation/admission/unknown outcomes; no fresh provider probe needed for this docs pass.
Interrupt without replacing session continuity remains distinct from cancel and steer.
Scope/action validation, selected-store list/get, exact redacted server/filter inventory and HTTP/SSE add implemented. sync is a callable retired refusal; project configuration remains daemon-owned.
Summary versus selected provider detail, invalid-provider refusal and peak advisories implemented. Discovery is not account membership or successful provider admission.

Invalid provider becomes no filter; empty task_ids removes the ID restriction, defaulting to the failed-task sweep when status is omitted; apply is default. Complete IDs are returned after effects and disk persistence is only requested. Lead the queue with pre-effect selector refusal.
Required message still stores and echoes unbounded message/needs/data before global response guard. Bound the admitted payload/receipt and expose exact report recovery.
Existing-session continuation with request-key replay and owner refusal remains distinct from fresh exec and thread reads.
Effectful resumed model turn, not passive detail. Prune retro docs say before dropping, while code drops first; correct ordering and partial outcome language.
Bounded summary, debug and exact result/report/structured-exit planes implemented. Debug remains field-specific evidence, not a universal redaction guarantee.
In-flight user input preserves current task continuity; distinct from resume after terminal work.

Bounded inventories, exact team/template pages, member caps, inert legacy advisors and project-template refusal implemented. Dissolve ignores cancellation/removal errors; delete failure can look like missing.
Unknown-task refusal and timeout snapshot maintained. Unvalidated negative or unrepresentable timeout reaches Duration conversion; validate before waiting.
Whole selection validated before waiting; 64-target cap, duplicate semantics and bounded mixed-outcome receipts implemented. Unknown-only refusal verified live; shared duration validation remains.
Whole selection validated before waiting; bounded terminal/success distinctions implemented. Unknown-only refusal verified live; negative or huge finite duration can panic after valid selection.
